questions.question: What library builds user interfaces with components?
questions.explanation: React is a component-based UI library.

questions.question: Which framework follows the MVC pattern?
questions.explanation: Angular implements Model-View-Controller architecture.

questions.question: What framework offers progressive adoption?
questions.explanation: Vue can be adopted incrementally in projects.

questions.question: What React feature manages application state?
questions.explanation: Hooks like useState manage state in React.

questions.question: Which syntax embeds HTML in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: JSX allows HTML-like syntax in JavaScript.

questions.question: What Angular feature enables two-way binding?
questions.explanation: ngModel creates two-way data binding in Angular.

questions.question: What Vue feature manages reactive data?
questions.explanation: The data function defines reactive state in Vue.

questions.question: What tool bundles JavaScript modules?
questions.explanation: Webpack bundles and optimizes JavaScript modules.

questions.question: Which framework compiles components at build time?
questions.explanation: Svelte compiles components to optimized JavaScript.

questions.question: What React feature enables code reuse?
questions.explanation: Components are reusable building blocks in React.

questions.question: Which company created and maintains React?
questions.explanation: Meta (formerly Facebook) created and maintains React.

questions.question: Which company develops the Angular framework?
questions.explanation: Google develops and maintains Angular.

questions.question: What does SPA stand for in web development?
questions.explanation: SPAs load one HTML page and update content dynamically.

questions.question: What does React use to update the browser DOM efficiently?
questions.explanation: The Virtual DOM batches and minimizes real DOM updates.

questions.question: Which package renders React components into the browser DOM?
questions.explanation: react-dom provides the renderer for web browsers.

questions.question: Which Vue directive renders an element for each item in a list?
questions.explanation: v-for loops over arrays to render lists.

questions.question: Which Vue directive dynamically binds an HTML attribute?
questions.explanation: v-bind syncs attributes with reactive data.

questions.question: Which Angular structure groups related components and services?
questions.explanation: NgModules organize Angular apps into cohesive blocks.

questions.question: Which language does Angular primarily require?
questions.explanation: Angular is built with and requires TypeScript.

questions.question: Which modern build tool provides instant dev server startup and HMR?
questions.explanation: Vite uses native ES modules for fast development.

questions.question: Which library handles client-side routing in React applications?
questions.explanation: React Router maps URLs to components.

questions.question: Which library provides official routing for Vue applications?
questions.explanation: Vue Router is the official Vue routing library.

questions.question: A marketing site needs server-rendered React pages for SEO. Which framework fits best?
questions.explanation: Next.js provides server-side rendering for React.

questions.question: Which meta-framework adds SSR and file-based routing on top of Vue?
questions.explanation: Nuxt is the official Vue meta-framework.

questions.question: What process attaches event listeners to server-rendered HTML on the client?
questions.explanation: Hydration makes static HTML interactive.

questions.question: Which file lists an npm project's dependencies and scripts?
questions.explanation: package.json declares dependencies and npm scripts.

questions.question: A React list throws a console warning and rows remount inefficiently because a required attribute is missing. Which one?
questions.explanation: React needs a stable key per list item to reconcile identity across renders.

questions.question: A product page must deliver complete HTML to crawlers on first hit, then hydrate into an interactive app. Which rendering strategy?
questions.explanation: SSR sends fully rendered HTML for SEO and speed, then hydrates with client JavaScript.

questions.question: In Vue, a cart total must recalculate only when its reactive dependencies change and stay cached otherwise. Which API?
questions.explanation: computed properties are cached by dependency tracking; methods re-run every render.

questions.question: Navigating from /products to /cart without a full page reload in an SPA is handled by what?
questions.explanation: Client-side routers intercept navigation and swap components while pushing history entries.

questions.question: A developer wants a value derived from state memoized so it recalculates only when dependencies change. In React, which hook?
questions.explanation: useMemo caches a computed value, recomputing only when listed dependencies change.
